questions.prompt: What is the completed (past) form of the -um- verb root 'kain' (eat)?
questions.explanation: In completed aspect, '-um-' infix is inserted after the first consonant: k-um-ain = kumain.

questions.prompt: What is the incompleted (present / habit) form of the verb root 'kain'?
questions.explanation: Incompleted aspect duplicates the first syllable of the root and inserts '-um-': k-um-a-kain.

questions.prompt: What is the contemplated (future) form of the root 'kain'?
questions.explanation: Contemplated aspect duplicates the first syllable of the root without '-um-': ka-kain.

questions.prompt: For mag- verbs, what prefix replaces 'mag-' in the completed (past) aspect?
questions.explanation: 'mag-' verbs change the initial 'm' to 'n' for completed aspect: magluto -> nagluto.

questions.prompt: What is the incompleted (present) form of 'mag-aral' (to study)? ______
questions.explanation: Incompleted aspect of mag- verbs: nag- + duplicate first syllable of root + root = nag-a-aral.

questions.prompt: What is the past (completed) tense of 'lakad' (walk) using -um-? ______
questions.explanation: Infix '-um-' placed after first consonant 'l': l-um-akad.

questions.prompt: What is the contemplated (future) tense of 'maglinis' (clean)?
questions.explanation: Future tense of mag- verbs keeps 'mag-' and duplicates the first syllable of root: mag-li-linis.

questions.prompt: In Actor Focus (AF) sentences, which entity is the topic marked by 'ang'?
options: The actor / doer of the action
questions.correct_answer: The actor / doer of the action
questions.explanation: In Actor Focus, the verb focuses on the performer of the action, who is marked with 'ang' or 'si'.
